programme.title: Dominican Republic, The Island Of Treasure
programme.sub-title: Discover The World: Dominican Republic, The Island Of Treasure
programme.desc: The Dominican Republic, the Caribbean's second-largest and most biodiverse country, offers mind-blowing nature, rich culture, and warm hospitality.

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: Samantha explores the history of the Abbey of the Genesee and the popular Monks’ Bread made by the Trappist monks. Samantha visits Chef Melanie Alvarez Santiago, to sample authentic Puerto Rican dishes. Samantha explores the "Grand Canyon of the East" and takes in the sights of Letchworth State Park then joins a community paint day and crafts a bucket at the Genesee Country Village & Museum.

programme.title: Epic Exploring
programme.desc: Urban explorer Cody Buffinton visits Morocco in search of an abandoned filmset in the Sahara Desert used for Game of Thrones.

programme.title: A Long Weekend in... With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Rory O’Connell’s brand new series combines travel and cookery with the popular chef enjoying the culture as well as the cuisine of eight European cities – Palma de Mallorca, Vienna, Lisbon, Madrid, Bath, Nantes, Copenhagen and Edinburgh. Rory visits a different city in each episode, and while the primary focus is on food, Rory is a knowledgeable guide to so much more, with art and design being particular interests of his. Food becomes much more interesting when seen in context – the culture it is part of the landscape it’s produced in, the history that has influenced it. At the end of each episode, Rory makes a delicious dish with the local produce which he sources on his travels.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Aimed at the adventure seeker, Departures is an action-packed and personal journey about two travelers. Scott Wilson and Justin Lukach leave their lives behind in search of unique experiences through some of the most beautiful and remote places on earth.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: Ancient Siam meets privacy and 'Intelligent Luxury' at Soneva Kiri, an award-winning luxury resort located on Thailand's 4th largest island, Koh Kood. Soneva are a thriving community working closely with the environment to craft incredible bespoke experiences, where discovery is a way of life. Richard learns about Soneva's "waste to wealth" policy, and visits Mandalay to learn more about the Soneva Foundation's Myanmar Stoves Campaign.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.sub-title: V Is For Vino - Napa, CA
programme.desc: Competition, controversy, and land that sell for 1M an acre! Napa Valley is the quintessential American wine region. It helped the USA gain the recognition it deserved in the wine world, and to this day still brings the thunder; but do you know the story of how it came to be? Find out on the premiere episode of V is for Vino.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Massimo Capra explores the Belle Isle area, one of the most beautiful settings in Northern Ireland. He meets-up with Chef Liz Moore and together they find giant sized rhubarb plants (really, they are taller than Massimo), meet the local butcher to get a pork belly and they make special sausages. Chef Liz has previously prepared a meal or two for the Queen of England. The Pressure is on Chef Massimo. Both have fun preparing a feast that will be served for a very elegant array of guests in a Royal dining room no less…this will be a meal fit for royalty!

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: The village of Lunenburg is known as the fishing capital of Canada. Chef Massimo joins forces with his friend Chef Konrad Haumering who gets the freshest mussels, halibut, lobster, scallops right off of the fishermen’s boats as they are brought in daily. All this happens within a short walk from his restaurant, truly right in front of his doors. They get the fresh catch of the day, a huge Flounder fish and they accentuate the meal by adding lobster. Massimo injects his Italian influence into the cooking while Chef Konrad adds his German flare resulting in a perfect ocean treat for their guests.
